messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — after qbringup on q4b we see a small quality shift on long-tail holdouts. Embedding recall down ~2% for a subset (~14 anchors). suspect short-prefix/KV-cache bias interacting with int4 kernels. Posting repro + sample ids.

 tanya: Can you paste the repro steps and the failing sample ids?

 sasha: repro curl:
`````
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' -d '{"model":"q4b-xyz","input":"<sample>"}'
`````
fail ids: ["a1f2","b3c4","d5e6", "f7g8","h9i0"] (DM me for full list). quick stats: control vs q4b mean embed_sim: 0.812 -> 0.795; prefix recall drop concentrated on 40-120 token prompts.

 ben: is tokenizer change in this deploy? or only quant kernels changed?

 sasha: only quant kernels + kvcache path. tokenizer same. suspect kernel fallback when seq_len > 64 leads to truncated prefix hits.

 labeler-bot: 14 golden items flagged for relabel due to regression detection (rule: embed_recall_delta > 0.03).

 ml-oncall: let's run a targeted canary: 200 samples from the flagged anchors, run q4b and control, collect prefix-kv cache hit rates and top5 recall. I'll add to infra queue.

 tanya: I'll own the golden relabel. plan: push 200 -> labeler queue with priority=high and tag "kvbias-q4b". will sample 50% from anchors and 50% similar neighs. update eval harness to compare topk recall, token-level drift, and embed sim.

 sasha: thanks. eval harness command (run in infra/canary):
`````
python infra/eval/canary.py --models control,q4b-xyz --dataset canary_kvbias_2026-03 --metrics topk_recall,embed_sim,prefix_hit_rate --out /tmp/q4b_canary.json
`````

 ben: ping @eng-runtime for kernel trace if we need to file a bug with vendor.

 tanya: relabel job created: job=LBL-20260321-09, expected turnaround 12h. tagging sessions so we can tie judgments to prompt variants.

 sasha: starting canary run now. will post results + logs in #eng-runtime and update this thread when canary completes. :eyes:
